description: This Java class is an implementation of the TaxRateDao interface, providing data access methods for TaxRate entities. It uses QueryDSL for building type-safe JPQL queries to retrieve tax rate data based on various filters such as store, country, zone, language, and code.

classes.name: TaxRateDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of data access object for TaxRate entities, providing methods to list, retrieve by code, ID, and filter tax rates based on store, country, zone, language, and tax class.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TaxRate objects associated with a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: listByStore with Language
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TaxRate objects for a specific MerchantStore filtered by Language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a single TaxRate by its unique code within a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxRate entity by its primary key ID.

methods.name: listByCountryZoneAndTaxClass
methods.description: Lists tax rates filtered by country, zone, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: listByCountryStateProvinceAndTaxClass
methods.description: Lists tax rates filtered by country, state/province, tax class, store, and language.
